name: smwmusic-tay-zonday-chocolate-rain
title: Tay Zonday - Chocolate Rain
description:
*I moved away from the spc player to breathe in*
This is Tay Zonday's most viral song, Chocolate Rain. I think you can find a few ports of it if you browse through some legacy packs, but there's no official submission so far. Quite surprising considering this song is 13 years old already.
However, since this has a quite short loop you should only use it for some bonus areas and such things.
